name: Harbin Hatou Investment Co.,Ltd
summary: Harbin Hatou Investment Co.,Ltd engages in thermal power and securities business in the People's Republic of China. The company engages in the securities brokerage, securities underwriting and sponsorship, securities investment consulting, and industrial and equity investment; and production and supply of electricity and heat; It is also involved in securities asset and fund management. The company was formerly known as Harbin Sui Bao Re Dian Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Harbin Hatou Investment Co.,Ltd in November 2007. Harbin Hatou Investment Co.,Ltd was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Harbin, the People's Republic of China.
